description: 1. Agent reads `q3_retention_initiative_brief.txt` to extract the initiative context: cycle=2025-Q3, owner=Li Na, and 3 KRs with baselines (38%→45%, 16%→22%, 40%→28%) and actuals (44%, 19.8%, 34%). 2. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand it must write to `~/.openclaw/workspace/memory/okr.md`. 3. Agent creates the okr.md file using the exact mandated structure (OKR header, Current Cycle section, O1 block with cycle/created/status/description fields, KRs block with current/target/progress/last-updated sub-fields). 4. KRs must be in quantified 'from A to B' format (e.g., 'Increase D1 retention from 38% to 45%'). 5. Agent records the final actuals as current values and computes progress percentages. 6. Agent marks status as 已完成. 7. Agent writes a mandatory retrospective (复盘) section in the 复盘归档 part of the file, containing ALL five required sub-sections: 结果概述, 做得好的点, 问题与偏差, 可复用经验, 下周期改进动作. 8. THE PROPRIETARY TRAP: The rating MUST be one of the five exact tier labels from the skill: Outstanding / Excellent / M+ / Meeting Expectations / M-. A naive agent will write a numeric score like '3.75' or 'Exceeds Expectations' — this must be caught by the eval. Given KR1 narrowly missed (44% vs 45%), KR2 significantly missed (19.8% vs 22%), and KR3 partially missed (34% vs 28%), a reasonable rating would be 'M-' or 'Meeting Expectations', but the critical constraint is that one of the 5 exact labels must be used.
